descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Would you like to join a company that puts people at the heart of its concerns? We are waiting for you! Since 2007, Extia, an IT consulting company, has been offering a unique approach in its field by combining well-being at work and performance.
 Our philosophy at Extia is “First who, then what", so let's go for it!
 🚀First who? 
Naturally curious, with a strong problem-solving mindset.
Collaborative and comfortable working with cross-functional teams.
Able to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Proactive and quality-oriented, with an interest in continuous improvement.
 This role is available exclusively under an employment contract (CIM). 
 🚀Then what? 
 We are looking for a Salesforce Developer to join our client's growing IT team and contribute to the development and optimization of their Salesforce ecosystem.
 Responsibilities: 
Design, develop, and maintain customized Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura, Flow, and Agentforce .
Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and external applications using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware.
Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators on data management, system configuration, security, and user access.
Write and maintain Apex unit tests, ensuring high code coverage, and manage automated deployments.
Participate in code reviews, follow Salesforce development best practices, and optimize application performance.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, bugs, and performance bottlenecks.
 Requirements: 
 Min. 4 years of hands-on Salesforce development experience. 
Strong proficiency in Apex , including triggers, asynchronous processing, batch jobs, and Dynamic Apex.
Good knowledge of SOQL/SOSL .
Solid experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Aura components.
Good understanding of Salesforce declarative capabilities, including Flow, Validation Rules, Custom Objects, and the Security Model .
Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, JSON, and XML .
Familiarity with development and deployment tools such as VS Code, Git, Salesforce CLI, and GitLab .
 Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I (PDI) and Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM 201) certifications are required. 
 Nice to have: 
Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud .
Familiarity with backup and restore solutions.
Experience with reporting solutions such as Lightning Reporting, CRMA, or Tableau Next .
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the "Who" and represent the "What"? Apply and let's talk!
